takeaway: Inferior parathyroid glands come from the 3rd pharyngeal pouch and can descend into the mediastinum with the thymus, so a mediastinal adenoma arises from there.

lines.text: A 35-year-old man has hypercalcaemia from primary hyperparathyroidism.
lines.say: A thirty-five-year-old man has hypercalcaemia from primary hyperparathyroidism.

lines.text: A technetium-labelled sestamibi scan finds a parathyroid adenoma.
It sits low, in the superior mediastinum.
Inferior parathyroid glands come from the 3rd pharyngeal pouch.
lines.say: Inferior parathyroid glands come from the third pharyngeal pouch.

lines.text: They can travel down into the chest together with the thymus,
so they can end up in the mediastinum.
So this mediastinal adenoma developed from the 3rd pharyngeal pouch.
lines.say: So this mediastinal adenoma developed from the third pharyngeal pouch.
